MTS Model 370.10 Load Frame - High Performance Landmark Servohydraulic Test System
Estimated Delivery: 4-6 Weeks
Ask For Price
The MTS Model FRAME37010 - MTS Model 370.10 Load Frame is part of the MTS Landmark Servohydraulic Test Systems designed for high performance, flexibility, and easy operation. Drawing on over four decades of testing expertise, this load frame offers exceptional stiffness, ergonomic design, and easy maintenance.
Product Features 
High performance and flexibility suitable for a wide range of static and dynamic tests 
Integrates latest MTS servohydraulic technology and FlexTest controls 
Compatible with MTS software and comprehensive accessory selection 
Available in floor-standing and tabletop configurations 
Supports testing of components like medical devices, truck dampers, and materials including plastics, elastomers, aluminum, composites, steel, and super alloys 
Highly stiff and ergonomic load frame for durability and ease of use 
Designed for fatigue life, fracture growth, tension, bending, and compression tests
Benefits 
Delivers reliable, accurate results across diverse testing applications 
Offers flexible configurations to meet evolving test requirements 
Ergonomic design reduces operator fatigue and simplifies maintenance 
Supports material development objectives with robust performance 
Enables efficient testing workflows with comprehensive software and accessory support
Why Choose the MTS Model 370.10 Load Frame?
With a heritage of over 40 years, the MTS Model 370.10 Load Frame combines cutting-edge servohydraulic technology and flexible configurations to meet the demands of modern material and component testing. Its robust design and versatile applications make it an ideal choice for labs seeking dependable performance now and in the future.
